cards.card_text: So the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says He will feed this people wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.
cards.verse_text: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will feed this people wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.
cards.snippet: …Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will feed this people wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.

cards.card_text: So the LORD of Hosts says He'll feed these prophets wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.
cards.verse_text: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts says concerning the prophets: “I will feed them wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink, for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has spread throughout the land.”

cards.card_text: He says God has filled him with bitterness, made him drunk on wormwood, ground his teeth with gravel and trampled him in the dust.
cards.verse_text: He has filled me with bitterness; He has intoxicated me with wormwood.
cards.snippet: He has filled me with bitterness; He has intoxicated me with wormwood.

cards.card_text: Then he says, "Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall." The wormwood shows up again, and I think that bitterness is still with him.
cards.verse_text: Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall.
cards.snippet: Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall.

cards.card_text: Then the message turns to a certain group: 'There are those who turn justice into wormwood and cast righteousness to the ground.'
cards.verse_text: There are those who turn justice into wormwood and cast righteousness to the ground.
cards.snippet: There are those who turn justice into wormwood and cast righteousness to the ground.

cards.card_text: That star has a name: Wormwood.
cards.verse_text: The name of the star is Wormwood.
cards.snippet: The name of the star is Wormwood.
